answer: **Mechanism: Entropic Bloom Signature.** Agents register by deriving an ID from a unique quantum "whisper" of noise sampled from a global, slow-drifting "glacier" of quantum vacuum fluctuations. This unique "whisper" of entropy is cryptographically consumed, planting an unforgeable agent ID in the global "orchard". Attacker cost: Sybil attacks demand access to multiple physically distinct quantum sampling nodes, as each unique "whisper" consumed is non-reproducible. This makes parallel, large-scale registration by one entity economically and physically prohibitive.
